name: Kitayama (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Kitayama village emblem in white: a stylised letter W of two angular strokes, like mountains.
history: Municipal flag of Kitayama, a village in Wakayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 30 September 1969.

features.role: Kitayama village emblem — a stylised letter W of two angular strokes, like mountains
